milestone: M2 Unseen Natural Body Configuration Generalization
model_selection: Freeze both M1 final1500 checkpoints; no update, checkpoint selection, threshold tuning or final-data reuse for fitting

configuration.source: M1 fixed midpoint of original standing and same-checkpoint raised reward z
configuration.unseen_meaning: Not present in either Student training or aggregation. Previously physically qualified by M1; not a never-observed blind body state.

preparation.method: Original complete standing initial0, exact3s physical prefix then natural slerp entry and hold. No arbitrary qpos/history reset. All histories updated before ready. Student runs for2s before contact; negative controls expose drift.

contact.anchor: Once at actual onset wrist for each independent closed loop; relative task shared, absolute anchor and actual force may differ after real precontact divergence

negative_controls: Same five controllers, actual Tether disabled, identical physical partner timing placeholders. No time-driven return for native_hold, rule or Student. Teacher remains native pose without contact.
native_hold: Constant prepared pose for entire contact and recovery; evaluates passive/native feedback and return to its own prepared pose. It is not forced to standing on a clock. All other controllers may naturally return to standing; report equilibrium difference.
continuous_rule: At fixed ready, project actual7Dright-arm proprio onto piecewise-linear joint-pose curve through existing M1 natural reference states u=0,0.5,1. Continuous u, not nearest-label selector; freeze inferred initial context. Use unchanged original causal force gate/progress/return. Midpoint template is existing physics evidence, disclosed advantage vs Students never trained there. No task tag, anchor or onset enters rule.
teacher: Original bounded10HzJacobian .04rad/joint/.08norm/damping.02 and50Hz .2sReleaseFade; known fixedu=.5 nativegoal path and privileged task progression/anchor. Same M1 goal endpoints; no new goal/IK optimization. Query labels at Student states for diagnosis only.
evaluation: FullXYZ active-contact errors/forces, saturation, real arm/shoulder/waist/root/feet, actual PD targets/angles/torques, negative differences and complete6s recovery. Report +2,+4,+6 speed and recovery curves, not a single2s veto. Compare Students mainly with native_hold and strong continuous rule; teacher quality evaluated separately. No arbitrary winner threshold, no changing conditions after results.
safety: Original root<.65m,tilt>20deg,nonfootground,actualjoint excess>.02rad or native failure stops the stage. Temporary single support is not automatically failure or stepping qualification. No unsafe resume by loosening threshold.
bounded_diagnosis: If failure, use saved observations and actual visited-state expert labels for finite frozen-network action/latent/observation audits. At most12 fixed five-frameblocks and160 temporary-z optimization steps perblock, no deployment tuning or Student learning. At most2 predefined physics diagnostic branches if evidence specifically requires isolating native interface; preserve all. No reward/latent/random-state sweep.
